qualifierQuotations.text: the victory which he obtained in front of the gulf

drafts.quotation: He called it after the victory which he obtained in front of the gulf, over Antony, and Cleopatra, the queen of Egypt, who was present in the engagement.
drafts.rationale: 'He' is Augustus, named earlier in the sentence chain; 'Antony' is Mark Antony. The passage says Augustus won a victory over Antony in front of the Ambracian Gulf, which the guidance equates with the battle at Actium.
drafts.relevance: Through the military lens, this records Augustus and Antony as the opposing sides in the victory at Actium.

drafts.subject: chr:entity:augustus

qualifierQuotations.text: the victory which he obtained in front of the gulf

drafts.quotation: He called it after the victory which he obtained in front of the gulf, over Antony, and Cleopatra, the queen of Egypt, who was present in the engagement.
drafts.rationale: 'He' is Augustus; Cleopatra, 'the queen of Egypt', who was present in the engagement, is the queen allied with Antony. The victory was over her as well.
drafts.relevance: Through the military lens, this records Cleopatra as an opponent of Augustus in the victory at Actium.

drafts.relevance: This shows the opposition between the victor's side and Antony in the aftermath of Actium, seen through the military lens.
